app_store.name: Hourhand: Booking Links
app_store.subtitle: Sync you can see. People reply
app_store.promotional_text: New: a sync light on every calendar. If one disconnects, we pause bookings and tell you, so nobody double-books.
app_store.description:
Hourhand turns your calendar into a booking link that keeps its word.

Share one link. Clients see only the times you are really free, pick one, and it lands in your calendar with a video link and a reminder.

Built for coaches, tutors, therapists and anyone who books their own clients.

What makes it different:
- A sync light for every connected calendar (Google, Outlook, iCloud). If one stops syncing, bookings pause and you get an alert. No surprise double-bookings.
- Availability that holds: date overrides, block a whole week, recurring sessions and one-off links, all from your phone.
- WhatsApp, SMS and email reminders, so fewer clients forget.
- Every time shows its time zone, with AM/PM or 24-hour clocks.
- A real person answers support within one working day.
- Cancel your plan in one tap. We email you 7 days before every renewal.

Free for one person. Duo covers you and an assistant for one flat price.
